## Total Score: 100/100

---

## Summary Assessment

Trevor is an exceptionally strong match. He satisfies **every required qualification** and **every preferred qualification**. His six years specifically in payments infrastructure (ACH, card settlement) directly mirrors the team's domain. He has hands-on ownership of Kafka/SQS pipelines, Terraform IaC, Kubernetes/Helm standardization, versioned REST API design, and on-call leadership — all explicitly sought by this role. The absence of a formal degree is explicitly accommodated by the job description's "equivalent practical experience" clause, which his nine-year track record and apprenticeship clearly satisfy.

**No meaningful gaps identified.**
